change.before: "newlines added to HTTP error response bodies"
change.after: "no newlines added to HTTP error response bodies"

exposure.needed: which client integrations consume Loki HTTP error response bodies and are sensitive to trailing newlines

consequence.statement: HTTP error response bodies returned by Loki no longer carry the regression's appended newlines; client integrations that parse those bodies see the restored format and should be verified against it.
consequence.remediation: Verify that client integrations reading Loki error responses tolerate error bodies without the appended newlines.

assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 fixes a regression that added newlines to HTTP error response bodies, so error response bodies no longer include the appended newlines that may have broken client integrations.
